posts.text: 今天泡了一壶新茶，配月饼刚好。
posts.gloss: Brewed a pot of new tea today. Perfect with mooncakes.

posts.text: 虚构县学校食堂用过期的肉，家长们在群里都炸了。
posts.gloss: A school cafeteria in Fictional County used expired meat. Parents in the group chat are furious.

posts.text: 早高峰骑车上班，比地铁还快。
posts.gloss: Biked to work in rush hour. Faster than the subway.

posts.text: 样本河边的工地，三个月没发工资了，工人们今天去讨薪。
posts.gloss: The building site by Sample River has not paid wages in three months. Workers went to demand their pay today.

posts.text: 刚才那条帖子被删了，再发一次：示例市化工厂昨晚又冒黑烟。
posts.gloss: My last post got deleted, posting again: the Sample City chemical plant was pouring out black smoke again last night.
